output.subject: Your visit to our Millbrook Plaza branch on September 5
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for writing to us about your visit to our Millbrook Plaza branch on Saturday, September 5. You told us you came in at about 10:15 that morning to deposit cash for your business. You said the teller who served you sighed loudly when you placed your bag on the counter. You also said they counted the deposit twice while making comments to a colleague about "people who can't use the ATM," and then told you to "come at a better time."

You mentioned that you have banked at that branch for twelve years and have never been made to feel that way before. We're sorry for how upsetting this experience was, and we appreciate you taking the time to tell us about it. Your relationship with us over those years matters, and we want you to feel welcome whenever you visit.

We have passed your complaint to our Branch & Contact Center team, who will review what you have described. We will respond to you within 10 business days.

Thank you again for raising this with us.

Kind regards,
Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: The draft refers to 'the teller who served you' and does not name the staff member. Decide whether naming them is appropriate.
Confirm the year of the September 5 visit, and check that it fell on a Saturday when the Millbrook Plaza branch was open.
The customer made no specific request, such as an apology or a callback. Decide what resolution, if any, to offer.
The customer included a phone number. Decide whether a phone follow-up is appropriate in addition to the email reply.
The customer is a long-standing business customer who makes cash deposits. Consider whether the reply should address branch deposit options for the future.
